sources.title: Original Tamagotchi Bright Garden | Product Information | BANDAI TOYS
sources.snippet:
From the ' Original Tamagotchi ' series, the European and American versions of the original ' tamagotchi' and 'New Species Discovered!! tamagotchi ',  
 " Original Tamagotchi Bright Garden" is now on sale!  
   
 Find the design that best reflects your personality!  
 This Original Tamagotchi features a design inspired by a garden in full bloom, creating a bright and cheerful atmosphere.  
 It features the GEN2 program, which allows you to raise Mimitchi and other characters. [...] Besides taking care of them by feeding them, flushing their poop, and treating their illnesses, you can also train them and play mini-games with them!  
   
 Depending on how you raise it, it will grow into various tamagotchi.  
   
 It can be attached to clothing or bags using the ball chain, allowing you to carry it around as a fashion item.  
   
 \This product's program includes some English text.  
 \ BANDAI does not sell screen protectors for LCD screens. [...] \The Images are for illustrative purposes only.  
   
 [Contents]  
 • Original Tamagotchi…1  
 • electronic manual…1  
   
 [Batteries used]  
 CR2032 x 1 (included)  
 \The included batteries are for testing purposes only.  
   
 (This product does not come with any products other than the set contents.)
